title: Evaluation and canonical derived restriction for internal pro-etale modules
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every scheme $X$, use its small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the coefficient ring $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and the category $\mathcal M_X=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}(\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathbf{Ab}))$ of internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. For $U\in X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, define $E_{X,U}:\mathcal M_X\to\mathbf{Ab}$ by forgetting the module action and evaluating the underlying abelian sheaf at $U$; on morphisms it evaluates the underlying sheaf map at $U$. For any morphism $a:Z\to X$, any such $U$, and any $\varphi:Z\to U$ with $u\circ\varphi=a$, where $u:U\to X$ is the structure morphism, define $\sigma_{a,U,\varphi}:E_{X,U}\to E_{Z,Z}\circ a^*$ by applying $E_{X,U}$ to the unit $M\to a_*a^*M$ of the internal-module adjunction [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] and then restricting sections along $(\varphi,\operatorname{id}_Z):Z\to U\times_X Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Here $E_{Z,Z}$ evaluates at the terminal object $\operatorname{id}_Z$. Define the ordinary unbounded derived restriction $RE_{X,U}\to RE_{Z,Z}\circ a^*$ to be the canonical right-derived pullback of $\sigma_{a,U,\varphi}$ [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], with exact $a^*$ acting termwise on complexes. Explicitly, after precomposition with the derived-evaluation unit and transport by the canonical exact-pullback factorization, its value on a complex is the termwise section restriction followed by the target derived-evaluation unit. These are constructions of evaluation and restriction; no invertibility assertion, properness assumption, or weak-contractibility hypothesis is imposed.

def closedFibreModuleDerivedRestriction {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Z ⟶ X)
    (U : X.ProEt) (φ : Z ⟶ U.left) (hφ : φ ≫ U.hom = a) :
    (closedFibreModuleEvaluation Λ X U).rightDerivedFunctor ⟶
      (upperStar Λ a).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (closedFibreModuleEvaluation Λ Z (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 Z))).rightDerivedFunctor
